The guarded mouth and averted gaze coexist with a bandaged recipient and a cup visibly partway into an open sleeve. Human arms, hands, and nails remain intact. Organic ears are present, but their directional reflex toward the recipient is ambiguous. The sleeve is oversized enough to weaken physical plausibility.

At thumbnail and native size, the late-twenties maid has a polished pretty-and-cute adult first read, ordinary human limbs, organic compact ears with clearly unequal angles, a guarded side glance, and a bandaged recipient.
